full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white experimental street photograph catches a person moving left-to-right across a dim night street. The person appears as a soft dark side profile and torso in the middle, their edges smeared by motion and slow exposure. Behind them, streaks of headlights and shop-window reflections sweep horizontally through wet air, creating pale linear bands. A broad diffuse glow hangs near the upper left, while the far side of the street dissolves into smoky gray shapes and framed light patches. The ground is dark and slightly reflective, but individual paving details are obscured. Scratches, faint dust, uneven emulsion, and low-contrast veiling make the image feel like a worked or aged darkroom print. The figure remains humanly recognizable even though facial features are lost. The central dark body interrupts the flowing light lines and anchors the composition. Rather than freezing a decisive instant, the photograph holds a span of passing time: movement, night glare, and reflective glass occupy one translucent plane. The tonal range is silver-gray to near-black, with no pure white except a few lamp streaks. The mood is solitary, elusive, and dreamlike, created by actual optical blur and layered exposure rather than a clean digital effect.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白实验街头照片捕捉一位人物从左向右穿过昏暗夜街。人物在中部呈柔暗侧面和躯干，慢曝光与运动使边缘拖散。背后车灯轨迹和店窗反射横向扫过潮湿空气，形成浅亮线带。左上附近悬着一团宽漫射光，远侧街道融成烟灰形体与框状亮块。地面深暗略反光，但单块铺地细节不可辨。划痕、淡灰尘、乳剂不均和低反差薄幕使影像像经过暗房处理或老化的照片。尽管面部特征丢失，人影仍能辨认。中央深身体打断流动光线并稳定构图。照片没有凝固一个决定性瞬间，而是容纳一段经过的时间：运动、夜间眩光与玻璃反射占据同一透明平面。调子由银灰至近黑，只有少数灯迹接近纯白。气氛孤独、难以捉摸且梦境般，由真实光学模糊与层叠曝光，而非干净数字特效生成。
style_prompt_en: Experimental monochrome night photography with slow-exposure motion smear, horizontally layered light streaks, reflective haze, and dark central interruption. Silver-gray glows emerge from near-black shadow through scratched, uneven emulsion. Facial or object detail stays partially lost to optical movement, leaving time and atmosphere visible as texture. The composition is elusive, grainy, and quietly solitary.
style_prompt_zh: 实验性单色夜间摄影，以慢曝光运动拖影、横向层叠光迹、反射薄雾和中央深色阻断组成。银灰光从近黑影里浮出，穿过有划痕、不均的乳剂表面。面或物体细节部分丢失于光学运动，使时间和空气显为肌理。构图难以捉摸、颗粒分明且安静孤独。
theme_en: A blurred passerby crossing a luminous night street
theme_zh: 一位模糊行人穿过发亮的夜间街道
name: Dirk Braeckman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
